events.title: 맨체스터 시티 sign German striker Uwe Rosler from Dynamo Dresden for £750,000. 맨체스터 유나이티드 reach their third League Cup final in four seasons with a 4–1 win at 셰필드 웬즈데이 in the semi-final second leg. Charlton and 울버햄프턴 원더러스 both reach the FA Cup quarter-finals.

아스널 heap misery upon 입스위치 타운, this time with a 5–1 league win at Portman Road in which 이언 라이트 scores a hat-trick. Meanwhile, 맨체스터 유나이티드 suffer their first home league defeat since October 1992 when they lose 1–0 to 첼시 at Old Trafford .
애스턴 빌라 climb into fifth place with a 1–0 win at Coventry.
New England manager 테리 베너블스 announces that 데이비드 플래트 , who currently plays for 삼프도리아 of Italy , will be the captain of the national team.
England beat Denmark 1–0 in a friendly at Wembley in their first game under 테리 베너블스.
Division One leaders 크리스털 팰리스 prepare for their inevitable return to the Premier League with a £1.1million move for 왓퍼드 striker Bruce Dyer .

The biggest win of the Premier League season so far sees 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 beat 스윈던 타운 7–1 at St James's Park. Peter Beardsley, Rob Lee and Steve Watson all find the net twice, with Ruel Fox also scoring. The consolation goal comes from John Moncur . QPR beat 노리치 시티 4–3 in a thrilling match at Carrow Road . In the FA Cup, 페테르 슈마이켈 is sent off for handling the ball outside the penalty area but 맨체스터 유나이티드 still beat Charlton 3–1 in the Old Trafford quarter-final. Bolton's FA Cup run ends with a 1–0 defeat at home to Oldham.
리버풀 beat 에버턴 2–1 in the last Merseyside derby at Anfield before the Spion Kop is rebuilt.
Midweek drama in the Premier League sees 맨체스터 유나이티드 return to their winning ways with a 5–0 home win over 셰필드 웬즈데이, which gives them a seven-point lead over 블랙번 로버스 with 11 games remaining.

에리크 캉토나 is sent off for stamping on John Moncur in 맨체스터 유나이티드's 2–2 league draw with 스윈던 타운 at the County Ground. 이언 라이트 scores a second successive Premier League hat-trick for 아스널 in a 4–0 win at 사우샘프턴. 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 win 4–2 at 웨스트햄 유나이티드. 노팅엄 포리스트's surge in Division One continues with a 3–2 win over Bolton which puts them just two points behind leaders 크리스털 팰리스.
Three days after being sent off against Swindon, 에리크 캉토나 is sent off again – also in a 2–2 draw, this time in the league against 아스널 at Highbury. Lee Sharpe scores both of United's goals.
루턴 타운 reach the FA Cup semi-final when a Scott Oakes hat-trick gives them a 3–2 win over 웨스트햄 유나이티드 in the quarter-final replay at Kenilworth Road .

맨체스터 시티 sign 에버턴 winger Peter Beagrie for £1.1million. He is succeeded at Goodison Park by 아스널's Anders Limpar for £1.6million. 토트넘 홋스퍼's quest to sign a new striker in an attempt to stave off relegation ends in failure when 웨스트햄 유나이티드's Clive Allen signs for Division One promotion chasers 밀월 for £75,000, ending talk his return to 토트넘 홋스퍼, who also fail to lure Frenchman 장피에르 파팽 from 바이에른 뮌헨 . Steve Morrow is reportedly set for a new 아스널 contract after a proposed move to a 스윈던 타운 side heading for relegation is called off. Another player going nowhere is QPR striker 레스 퍼디낸드 , who has been subject to transfer speculation for months. Joining Anders Limpar at Goodison Park is 20-year-old 본머스 midfielder Joe Parkinson , a hot prospect costing £250,000. 레스터 시티 boost their promotion challenge with a £360,000 move for 포츠머스 midfielder Mark Blake . 윔블던 sign 브렌트퍼드 striker Marcus Gayle for £250,000. Loan moves include Jeroen Boere (웨스트햄 유나이티드 to 포츠머스), Ian Kilford (노팅엄 포리스트 to 위건 애슬레틱 ), Tom Cowan (셰필드 유나이티드 to 허더즈필드 타운), Scott Marshall and Jimmy Carter (both 아스널 to 옥스퍼드 유나이티드) and Paul Dickov (아스널 to Brighton & Hove Albion ).

풀럼 manager Don Mackay is sacked at half-time by chairman Jimmy Hill , with the team losing 2–0 to fellow strugglers 레이턴 오리엔트 . Former manager Ray Lewington is put in charge again for the second half, during which the Cottagers score twice and salvage a 2–2 draw. In the Premier League, 블랙번 로버스 cut 맨체스터 유나이티드's lead to three points with a 3–1 home win over Swindon. In Division One, 노츠 카운티 home in on the playoff places with a 3–1 home win over East Midlands rivals 레스터 시티.
맨체스터 유나이티드's bid for a unique domestic treble ends when they lost 3–1 to 애스턴 빌라 in the 1994 Football League Cup Final .
셰필드 유나이티드 boost their survival bid with a 3–2 home win over 웨스트햄 유나이티드.

블랙번 로버스's hopes of catching 맨체스터 유나이티드 in the title race are dealt a major blow when they lose 4–1 away to 윔블던. Andy Cole becomes the first player to reach the 30-goal mark in the Premier League when he scores in 뉴캐슬 유나이티드's 3–0 home win over 노리치 시티.

맨체스터 유나이티드 extend their lead of the Premier League to six points with a 1–0 win over 리버풀, in which 폴 인스 scores the only goal. Oldham climb out of the bottom three with a 3–1 win at 사우샘프턴, who take their place in the relegation zone.

맨체스터 유나이티드's treble bid may be over, but they finish March as Premier League leaders by a six-point lead over their nearest rivals 블랙번 로버스. They are also in the FA Cup semi-finals . 뉴캐슬 유나이티드, 아스널 and 리즈 유나이티드 complete the top five. 올덤 애슬레틱, who will soon be competing in the FA Cup semi-final with 맨체스터 유나이티드, are starting to look set for Premier League survival as they have climbed out of the relegation zone at the expense of 사우샘프턴, while 셰필드 유나이티드 and 스윈던 타운 remain there. In Division One, 크리스털 팰리스 continue to head the table and have been joined in the automatic promotion places by a 노팅엄 포리스트 side who weren't even in the playoff zone a month ago. 레스터 시티, 밀월, 더비 카운티 and 트랜미어 로버스 occupy the playoff zone.
